package.description: A simple file viewer for Mobi format e-books.

en-US.description: A simple file viewer for Mobi format e-books.
en-US.longDescription: Mobi File Reader is a free and simple file viewer for Mobi e-book files. It can help you to open a Mobi file, convert and save Mobi files as Text and HTML files. With a clean and friendly interface, this compact software is easy to use. In addition, this is completely free for personal use.
